Matches the allow-list previously enforced inline in DatabaseManager.

requests.description: What the database pod asks for; used for scheduling.

ProjectScopeConfig.description:
``scope: project`` -- one dedicated CNPG cluster per project, shared by all its
deployments. Carries the same CNPG-cluster fields as
``namespace-postgresql-database``.

image.description: PostgreSQL image for the cluster. Must be CNPG-compatible (a postgres user with UID 26).
image.title: Image

instances.description: Number of PostgreSQL instances; more than one gives a replicated cluster.
instances.title: Instances

postInitSQL.description: SQL statements run once, when the database is first created (extensions, dictionaries).
postInitSQL.title: Postinitsql

privileges.description: Extra PostgreSQL role privileges for the project's database user, from the allowed set.
privileges.title: Privileges

registry.description: Named registry from the project's 'registries' list to pull the image from; none means public.
registry.title: Registry

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits for the database pods.

schemas.description: Extra schemas alongside the default one, shared by every deployment.
schemas.title: Schemas

scope.description: One dedicated PostgreSQL cluster for this project, shared by all its deployments.
scope.title: Scope

storage.description: Size of the database volume as a Kubernetes quantity, e.g. 10Gi.
storage.title: Storage

RequestsQuantities.description:
CPU/memory *requests*. Per-field defaults preserve the old deep-merge: a
config overriding only ``requests.memory`` keeps the default ``cpu``.

cpu.description: CPU the database pod requests, e.g. 100m.
cpu.title: Cpu

memory.description: Memory the database pod requests, e.g. 256Mi.
memory.title: Memory

SchemaEntry.description:
One extra schema, project-wide (RC-17 decision 10.5).

``postfix`` is the user-chosen short name; the full schema becomes
``{project}_{deployment}_{postfix}`` per deployment and an env variable
``DATABASE_SCHEMA_{POSTFIX}`` is exposed. The pattern keeps the postfix a valid
identifier fragment; uniqueness within the list, the 63-char full-name limit and
variable-name collisions are enforced at save time (they need the project and
deployment names, which this model does not have).

description.description: What this schema is for, for whoever reads the project file.
description.title: Description

marked-for-deletion.description: Marks the schema as no longer wanted instead of dropping it: the schema and its data stay, and its variable is no longer exposed.
marked-for-deletion.title: Marked-For-Deletion

postfix.description: Short name of the extra schema, at most 32 characters. The full name becomes {project}_{deployment}_{postfix} and its connection details are exposed as DATABASE_SCHEMA_{POSTFIX}. The full name must also stay under PostgreSQL's 63-character limit for every deployment, which depends on the project and deployment names and is therefore checked when the change is saved.
postfix.title: Postfix

SchemaEntry.title: SchemaEntry

SharedScopeConfig.description:
``scope: shared`` -- a database on the shared cluster instance (the default).

Carries no CNPG-cluster fields: ``extra="forbid"`` means putting ``storage`` or
``instances`` here fails validation with a message that names the offending key.

schemas.description: Extra schemas alongside the default one, shared by every deployment.
schemas.title: Schemas

scope.description: A database on the shared cluster instance; the default.
scope.title: Scope

SharedScopeConfig.title: SharedScopeConfig

description:
Project-layer config: a ``scope``-discriminated union of the two shapes above.

``scope`` defaults to ``shared`` when absent, so an existing project that sets no
scope validates as a shared database and its behaviour is unchanged.
title: PostgresqlDatabaseProjectConfig
